Dr. Suffiyah Webb

Hoboken + Newark, NJ

When Suffiyah Webb was twelve, she commuted from Newark to Hoboken, taking two buses and a train. She started her first business on those train platforms, playing saxophone for spare change with her friends. It was her first experience building something of her own, of the entrepreneurial spirit.
